readerCopy.headline: Give the dream somewhere to land.
readerCopy.body:
A creative idea finds the person who can help you make it. A spiritual practice becomes part of the week instead of something you keep meaning to return to. A compassionate impulse becomes practical help rather than a feeling you carry home and forget by morning.

Jupiter sextile Neptune gives inspiration a doorway into real life. Use it while the feeling is alive. Write the page, schedule the hour, fund one small part, or make the first offer of help. The dream does not need a grand launch. It needs somewhere to exist.
